reason: `PGTaskDurability.engine_spec.toolset_lifecycles['dynamic']` changes from `'enter-never'` to `'enter-in-durable-unit'`. The value now decides whether a `per_run_step=False` dynamic toolset is resolved once per run and held for the steps (`DurableDynamicToolset.for_run`, its only reader). Before, every engine held it regardless of this value; declaring `'enter-in-durable-unit'` keeps that for pgtask, whose steps run in the process that holds it. No existing code needs to change.
